name: cx-sequence
task: Find the key, pick it up, open the locked door, go into the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task states an order — find the key, pick it up, open the locked door, enter the room, then pick up the ball — but the candidate contains only Existence(target_picked_up), so nothing enforces the sequence. Add hard Precedence clauses between consecutive steps: Precedence(key_found, has_matching_key), Precedence(has_matching_key, target_door_open), Precedence(target_door_open, target_room_entered), and Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up), keeping the hard Existence(target_picked_up). The chain with the final Existence forces every earlier step, so no extra Existence clauses are needed.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) hard requires the final pickup, and the Precedence chain (key_found → has_matching_key → target_door_open → target_room_entered → target_picked_up) captures each stated order step and forces every earlier event, so no redundant Existence clauses are needed.
